verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik icha tik:
Ab' wal tas syal in trato, tzalan t'a heb' aj Judá yet' pax t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' to a in Jehová sDiosal in heb', a in swala' to skatab'aj mach max k'anab'ajan tas syal in trato tik.

Haton in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham, ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha jun nación chi', lajan yaj t'a heb' icha junok horno b'aj stz'a k'e'en hierro. Walannak t'a heb': k'anab'ajejinek, b'o'ek masanil tas swala'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ha exxo pax tik, tato ol in he k'anab'ajej, ol wak'nhej elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham, yik swak'an jun he lu'um, haton lum te yax sat b'aj ayex ek' tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix in tak'wi t'ay icha tik: Ujokab' Mamin Jehová, xin chi.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak scalle'al Jerusalén. Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Maklejek eyab' jun trato tik, tze b'eyb'alan tas syala'.
Ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, cham wal walnak t'a heb' to scha yab' heb' tas swala'. Atax t'a jun pekti' chi' masanto tikne'ik ayinnhejoch walani.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej to wach' pitb'inakel spensar heb'. Yak'annakb'at sb'a heb' t'a skal chukal. Maj yal sk'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej tas swala'. Yuj chi' wak'nakb'at yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha yajkan t'a in trato chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, ix slajti'ej sb'a heb' yik syik'anel sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.

Ix sk'ulejxi chukal heb' icha sb'eyb'alejnak heb' he mam eyicham. Haton heb' manh k'anab'ajannakok tas walnak, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios yak'nakoch spensar heb', yochnak heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ha pax tikne'ik manhok chonhab' Israel, manhok pax chonhab' Judá sk'anab'ajan in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wak'kot yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' t'ay. Olto awaj heb' t'ayin sk'anan in kolwal, palta manhxo ol in tak'wok t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' b'i'an a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik, ol b'at snhus incienso heb' yik sk'anan kolwal t'a juntzanh sdiosal chi'. Yujto a heb' aj Judá tik, tzijtum wal sdiosal heb', lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb'. Hanheja' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, te tzijtum altar ix sb'ok'e heb', icha wal scalle'al chonhab', haton ta' snhus incienso heb' t'a Baal, jun komon Dios yajb'entak. Palta manh ol yal-laj skolji heb' t'a syahelal chi' yuj juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.
Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok, wach'chom ol sk'an in kolwal heb' t'a skal syahelal.

Ix yalan Jehová to swal t'a heb' wetchonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab' xajanab'il wu'uj, malaj eyalan heyik he jawi t'a in kajnub', yujto manh jantakok tas yajb'entak tze k'ulej. Ha xepu'al yet' schib'ejal nok' he silab', manh ol yal ex skolanel t'a jun yahelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Manhxo eyak'och k'inh t'a in kajnub' tik.

Yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo, lajan ex icha junok te' olivo k'ayum xi'il, te ay sat. Palta haxo tikne'ik, ol ex in sateli, icha tz'aj slajwi'em junok te te' sjekchaj sk'ab' yuj junok owal ik' nhab', stz'ab'at te' yuj sk'ak'al lheb'lon.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in ix ex wak' pitzwok ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, icha yawchaj junok te te'. Palta toxo ix wala' to ol ex in satel yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej, icha junok te te' stok'jik'eta t'a yol lu'um. Ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol, yujto ix he nhus incienso t'a Baal, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ay heb' ajk'ol t'ayin wan sna'an in smilani. Ix a jak in pensar yik snachajel wu'uj.

Junk'olal wajek'i, icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok, palta manh wojtakok tas wan sna'an heb' t'a in patik. Syalan heb' icha tik: Ko mak'ekchamok, yik wach' manhxa mach ol na'ankotok, icha wal tz'aj xikji'el junok te te' syak' sat, xchi heb'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, Juez ach t'a stojolal. Ojtak tas ayek' t'a ko pensar. Ak' wil tas ol aj ak'an spak t'a juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wab'enejoch t'a yol a k'ab' tas sna heb' t'a in patik, xin chi.
Ha heb' aj Anatot, ix sna heb' tas tz'aj in chami. Ix yalan heb' to tzin smilcham heb' tato hanheja' walanel slolonel Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix halan yuj heb' aj Anatot chi' icha tik: Ayik ol in b'o'an yaj yet' heb', a heb' kelemtak ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, haxo yuninal heb' yet' yisil, ol cham heb' yuj wejel.
Manhxa junok heb' winak ol kanok, yujto ol ja sk'uhal ol in ch'olb'itan tas sk'ulej heb'. Ol jawok yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová.
